TURN ACTION INTO PROGRESS

Log an activity

Log real sessions. XP and decay both follow what you actually did.

XP is a game-design reward, not a scientific measure of your worth. You can edit activity rules and XP values at any time.

XP preview

25estimated total XP

30 min = base XP. Duration scales up to 3× at 90+ min. Quality multiplies on top. Repeating the same activity type 3+ times today reduces the award.

RULES & DATA

Settings & data

Hard rules when you want them. Data stays in this browser unless you export it.

Appearance

Light mode
Switch between the dark and light appearance. This only changes how the app looks.

Navigation

Swipe to switch tabs
Swipe left or right with one finger to move between tabs. Ignored near the screen edges, on scrolling strips, sliders, the cat room and the Life Director.
The Android Back button or gesture closes a popup, then returns to the previous tab. It never closes the app.

App updates

New builds come from this app’s GitHub releases. Android asks you to confirm each install.

Home-screen widget

Your Life Director dial on the home screen: today’s plan, a moving hand for now, and what is on or next.

Health sync

Turns your Samsung Health activity into XP automatically, through Android’s Health Connect.

Automatic backup

Your data lives only on this phone. Pick a folder, such as Drive or Downloads, and a backup file is written there automatically.

Notifications

Smart reminders for workouts and planned sessions. Everything is scheduled on this phone.

Character profile

Name, build, and profile picture stay on this device.

Profile picture
Cropped to a square. Stays in this browser.

Rewards

Sparks, perks, accent colours, cat toys, streak shields and attribute ascension.

Decay system

After the grace period with no training, the attribute loses XP daily. Skill XP does not decay. Turn this off only if you want a softer game.

Enable decay

Developer mode

Testing tools. When on, each attribute sheet gains a test activity that awards +2 levels for that attribute only.

Enable developer mode
Adds “Dev: +2 levels” under every attribute’s activity list, and test buttons for the cat (Cat → Developer).
Open Character → any attribute (or Overview attribute cards). At the top of the list you’ll see Dev: +2 levels and Dev: +1 level for that attribute only.
A shared notes thread for Claude, ChatGPT, Grok and you.
Switch class (testing). Ends your current plan and swaps in that class's quests. XP stays.
Opens the class selector. Pick a different class and tap the button to switch to it (ends your current plan, XP stays). Closing without switching changes nothing.

XP rules

Edit the base XP for each activity. Changes apply to future logs.

Data management

Export backup
Download all activities, stats, quests and settings.
Export report
A readable summary of your character, stats and full history.
Import backup
Restore a previously exported Life Max file.
Reset demo data
Restore the starter profile and sample quests.
Delete all local data
Permanently clear this browser's Life Max save.
Prototype privacy: data is stored locally in this browser using localStorage. It is not a secure account system or cloud backup. Anyone using this browser profile may be able to access it. Export a backup before clearing browser data.
